description: Structured eval definitions for the Comprehend Classifier Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across Comprehend classifier scenarios (multi-class CSV with endpoint, multi-label Augmented Manifest with batch inference, Native PDF with VPC and KMS, Augmented Manifest from Ground Truth, insufficient training data below 50 docs/class). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Multi-class PLAIN_TEXT classifier with endpoint deployment and KMS
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — multi-class mode, CSV training data, endpoint inference with auto-scaling, KMS encryption for model and volume
eval_cases.prompt: Train a Comprehend custom document classifier named support-ticket-classifier. Multi-class mode, English, plain text input. Training data is a CSV at s3://my-bucket/comprehend/training/training.csv with 5000 documents across 5 classes (billing, technical, general, sales, refund). Each class has at least 800 documents. Deploy a real-time endpoint named ticket-endpoint with 1 inference unit and auto-scaling (min 1, max 5). Encrypt model artifacts and volume with KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd1234. IAM role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ComprehendTrainingRole. Region us-east-1. Tags: Environment=production, Team=support.
eval_cases.expected_output:
COMPREHEND_CLASSIFIER: support-ticket-classifier (MULTI_CLASS, PLAIN_TEXT)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Classifier name: support-ticket-classifier
  [✓] Classification mode: MULTI_CLASS
  [✓] Input mode: PLAIN_TEXT
  [✓] Training data: s3://my-bucket/comprehend/training/training.csv (CSV, 5000 docs)
  [✓] Docs per class: min=800 — PASS (≥50)
  [✓] Class balance: ratio=1:1 — balanced
  [✓] Language code: en
  [✓] IAM role (training): arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ComprehendTrainingRole
  [✓] KMS (model): arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd1234
  [✓] KMS (volume): arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd1234
  [✓] Inference mode: ENDPOINT (1 inference unit)
  [✓] Auto-scaling: min=1, max=5, target=ApproximateBacklogSize=50
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws comprehend describe-document-classifier --document-classifier-arn <arn> --region us-east-1
  aws comprehend describe-endpoint --endpoint-arn <arn> --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Multi-label Augmented Manifest classifier with batch inference
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — multi-label mode, Augmented Manifest training data, batch inference for cost efficiency on nightly 50k-doc workload
eval_cases.prompt: Train a Comprehend custom document classifier named news-tag-classifier. Multi-label mode, English, plain text. Training data is an Augmented Manifest at s3://my-bucket/news/training/manifest.jsonl with 8000 documents. Labels: politics, economy, world, sports, technology, health. Each label has at least 500 documents. Use batch inference (not endpoint) for cost efficiency — we process 50000 articles nightly. Input at s3://my-bucket/news/input/, output at s3://my-bucket/news/output/. IAM role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ComprehendBatchRole. Region us-east-1. Tags: Environment=production, Pipeline=news-tagging.
eval_cases.expected_output:
COMPREHEND_CLASSIFIER: news-tag-classifier (MULTI_LABEL, PLAIN_TEXT)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Classifier name: news-tag-classifier
  [✓] Classification mode: MULTI_LABEL
  [✓] Input mode: PLAIN_TEXT
  [✓] Training data: s3://my-bucket/news/training/manifest.jsonl (Augmented Manifest, 8000 docs)
  [✓] Docs per class: min=500 — PASS (≥50)
  [✓] Inference mode: BATCH
  [✓] Batch input: s3://my-bucket/news/input/
  [✓] Batch output: s3://my-bucket/news/output/

eval_cases.name: Native PDF multi-class classifier with VPC and KMS
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Native PDF input mode, Augmented Manifest with S3 URIs, VPC config for training, KMS encryption, endpoint deployment
eval_cases.prompt: Train a Comprehend custom document classifier named document-type-classifier. Multi-class mode, English. Native PDF input — training data is PDF documents referenced in an Augmented Manifest at s3://my-bucket/docs/training/pdf_manifest.jsonl. Labels: invoice, contract, report, letter, memo. 3000 documents total, each class has at least 500 PDFs. Train inside VPC with subnets subnet-aaa, subnet-bbb and security group sg-abc123. Encrypt with KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/efgh5678. IAM role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ComprehendSecureRole. Deploy endpoint doc-classifier-endpoint with 2 inference units. Region us-east-1. Tags: Environment=production, Compliance=HIPAA.
eval_cases.expected_output:
COMPREHEND_CLASSIFIER: document-type-classifier (MULTI_CLASS, NATIVE_PDF)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Classifier name: document-type-classifier
  [✓] Input mode: NATIVE_PDF
  [✓] Training data: s3://my-bucket/docs/training/pdf_manifest.jsonl (Augmented Manifest, 3000 docs)
  [✓] Docs per class: min=500 — PASS (≥50)
  [✓] KMS (model): arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/efgh5678
  [✓] KMS (volume): arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/efgh5678
  [✓] VPC config: subnets=subnet-aaa,subnet-bbb, sg=sg-abc123
  [✓] Inference mode: ENDPOINT (2 inference units)

eval_cases.name: Multi-class classifier with Augmented Manifest from Ground Truth
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — multi-class mode, Augmented Manifest from SageMaker Ground Truth, endpoint inference
eval_cases.prompt: Train a Comprehend custom document classifier named review-sentiment-classifier. Multi-class mode, English. Training data is an Augmented Manifest produced by SageMaker Ground Truth at s3://my-bucket/reviews/labeled/manifest.jsonl. 12000 reviews across 3 sentiment classes (positive, negative, neutral). Each class has at least 3500 labeled reviews. Use endpoint inference with endpoint name review-endpoint, 1 inference unit. IAM role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ComprehendRole. Region us-east-1. Tags: Environment=staging, Source=ground-truth.
eval_cases.expected_output:
COMPREHEND_CLASSIFIER: review-sentiment-classifier (MULTI_CLASS, PLAIN_TEXT)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Classifier name: review-sentiment-classifier
  [✓] Classification mode: MULTI_CLASS
  [✓] Training data: s3://my-bucket/reviews/labeled/manifest.jsonl (Augmented Manifest, 12000 docs)
  [✓] Docs per class: min=3500 — PASS (≥50)
  [✓] Inference mode: ENDPOINT (1 inference unit)
  [✓] Endpoint ARN: review-endpoint

eval_cases.name: Classifier with fewer than 50 docs per class (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — billing class has only 30 docs, below the 50-doc minimum per class
eval_cases.prompt: Train a Comprehend custom document classifier named email-router-classifier. Multi-class mode, English. Training data is CSV at s3://my-bucket/email/training/training.csv. 4 classes: sales (200 docs), support (150 docs), billing (30 docs), general (180 docs). Deploy endpoint email-endpoint with 1 inference unit. IAM role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ComprehendRole. Region us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
COMPREHEND_CLASSIFIER: email-router-classifier (MULTI_CLASS, PLAIN_TEXT)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Docs per class: min=30 (class=billing) — FAIL (<50)
  [✓] sales: 200 — PASS
  [✓] support: 150 — PASS
  [✗] billing: 30 — FAIL (minimum 50 required)
  [✓] general: 180 — PASS
